messages.author: 649d11b722428382
messages.subject: Equivalent of lme4::glmer() in lavaan
parts:
Hello All,

I come from the multilevel modeling world and am pretty brand new to SEM.

Do please forgive my basic question: but is the equivalent of the
following model possible to be fit with lavaan? Will the results
approximately match?

Sincerely,
Simon

library(lme4)

dat <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fpqq/w/main/d.csv")

form <- y ~ item_type*time + (0 + item_type | user_id)

model <- glmer(form, family = binomial, data = dat,
control =
glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
optCtrl=list(maxfun=1e4)))

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Equivalent of lme4::glmer() in lavaan
parts:
Hello Simon,

I am afraid lavaan has (currently) no support for models with a
non-normal outcome and random effects.

I would have a look at IRT packages like mirt.

Yves.
